evidence.title: Quick Start with Icon Font | Hugeicons Documentation

name: Quick Start with Hugeicons Free Icon Font
summary: Docs page for the free icon font: 6,000+ stroke-rounded icons installed via CDN in WOFF2, WOFF, TTF, EOT and SVG formats.
description: Guide to putting the free icon font on a site: link the CDN stylesheet, use <i> tags with hgi-stroke class names, and choose among five font formats. The page states the free set has 6,000+ icons usable without attribution, and that the Pro tier adds 60,000+ icons in 10 styles.
contains: formats: WOFF2, WOFF, TTF, EOT, SVG
